description.p: Nomadeer rides alongside your EVE Online session and keeps track of the wormhole space around you, so you can spend less time on notes and more time flying.

ul.li: Chain mapping: follow your characters as they jump and build an interactive map of the connections you find
Character tracking: see which system each of your characters is in and follow their movement
Killboard intel: recent kills and activity for the selected system, so you know who has been through before you arrive
Umbra: an optional on-device companion that watches the killboards and gives you a short briefing on the selected system

description.p: Nomadeer is a fan-made tool and is not affiliated with CCP Games.

screenshot.caption: The chain map with wormhole and faction artwork, system intel and Umbra's briefings
